column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran keempat puluh lima ekor panjang.
# Bagian 4 dari sepuluh berkas (75-84). Tetap 1:1, harfiah ("=").
# Nama jenis senjata (RF, AR, SMG, HG) dibiarkan Inggris — itu istilah permainan
# yang dipakai pemain sehari-hari, bukan kata benda biasa.
# --- serangan ---

=Selects <color=#f26c1c>one</color> direction and deals melee AoE Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> of attack to all enemy units in a <color=#f26c1c>forward-facing 5x3 area</color>, applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, and generates <color=#e67129>{2}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.

column1: =Select an unoccupied Freeze or Burn tile <color=#f26c1c>on the entire battlefield</color>, land on it, and deal AoE <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> to all enemy targets <color=#f26c1c>within 4 tiles</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> of attack.
